Collapsible Travel Cups ↗

Collapsible silicone cups: what to confirm

Collapsible cups are defined by open size, folded size and capacity. Confirm all three, plus the lid and packing, before sampling.

What sizes do collapsible cups come in?

Capacity, open height and folded height are model-specific and can be customized to the project.

Are silicone cups heat resistant?

Heat limits depend on the silicone grade. Request the documentation for the exact reference.

Can collapsible cups be printed?

Pad printing is commonly used on curved silicone surfaces; confirm the artwork and surface first.

Review material, dimensions and care by model

A silicone material description does not establish impact resistance, food-contact suitability, freezer use or heat limits. Share beverages, temperatures, cleaning and venue requirements, then review the exact material, construction and sample. Select a folding structure only for references identified as collapsible, and agree target capacity and open/folded dimensions for the project.

折叠旅行杯 ↗

折叠硅胶杯需要确认什么

折叠杯由展开尺寸、折叠尺寸和容量三个参数定义。打样前请同时确认这三项以及杯盖与包装。

折叠杯有哪些尺寸？

容量、展开高度和折叠高度按型号确定，也可按项目定制。

硅胶杯耐温吗？

耐温取决于硅胶等级，请索取具体型号的资料。

折叠杯可以印刷吗？

硅胶弧面常用移印，请先确认图稿与表面。

按型号核对材料、尺寸与使用条件

硅胶材料名称不构成防摔、食品接触、冷冻或耐热证明。请说明实际饮品、温度、清洁及场馆要求，按具体材料、结构和样品核对。只有标明可折叠的型号才按折叠结构选型；目标容量与展开、折叠尺寸按项目确认。
